record.oneLiner: Pylon is a B2B customer support and ticketing platform featuring a REST API authenticated with API tokens and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
record.verdictReason: Pylon offers a fully documented public REST API secured via API token (Bearer authentication). While a paid plan is required to use the product and its API, credentials can be generated self-serve within an active workspace and an official MCP server is provided.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication. This means you’ll need to pass your API token in the header of your request
Professional is $89 per seat/month, annual contract ... MCP, API, integrations

GET /accounts/{id} HTTP/1.1
Host: api.usepylon.com
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN
The Pylon MCP Server exposes Pylon data to AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
